rules.D1: PASS iff every check of A, B, C1, G0 and R0 holds on all 3 grids and all cases
rules.D2: reference: row Gershgorin discs of the mode blocks B_m (THEORY 5.2). PASS iff rho_F <= rho_G (1 + 1e-12) and alpha_F <= alpha_G + 1e-12 scale in every case and rho_F < rho_G (1 - 1e-9) or alpha_F < alpha_G - 1e-9 scale in every case with non-zero velocity; FAIL iff some case is looser; KILL iff no case is strictly tighter
rules.exit: 0 iff every check of A, B, C1, G0, R0 holds and every C2 metric is finite
